info.title: v2.livestream.get_item_set_list
info.description: Get the product set of the live stream, including the product set name, id, and item number. (For TW, ID, TH, PH, MY, SG, VN)

get.description: Get the product set of the live stream, including the product set name, id, and item number. (For TW, ID, TH, PH, MY, SG, VN)

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search the item set with it's name matching the keyword.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is 0, if data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data. The limit of page_size if between 1 and 100.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by(depends on different APIs) partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, user_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a user.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/livestream/get_item_set_list?access_token=access_token&keyword=set&offset=0&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
